name: captcha
what: Library that generates image and audio CAPTCHAs.

bare.edit: the request alone: no description, nothing added to the README

use.context: Some context: I'm on the account security team. We use our fork of this library to generate the image and audio CAPTCHAs on our sign-up form, which keep automated sign-ups out. The pass rates for people and for bots tell us how well the challenges work, and the numbers go into the security review.
